data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password**\.

It offers one of the best balances of security, ease of use, team sharing, and administrative controls. It's particularly good for teams that need to share credentials without sharing passwords through Slack, email, or spreadsheets.

That said, the best choice depends on your team size, budget, and whether you need more than basic password storage.

## Best password managers compared

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Very user-friendly across devices
- Strong administrative controls
- Great for nontechnical employees
  
  Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business: \$8.99/user/month.
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source platform
- Secure shared collections
- Audit logs and directory integration
- Good administrative features for the price
  
  Teams: approximately \$4/user/month, billed annually.
  
  [Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

- Strong administrative controls
- Shared folders and delegated administration
- Good for compliance-conscious organizations
  
  Business Starter: approximately \$2/user/month; check eligibility and limits.
  
  [Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- Security monitoring and phishing protection
- Useful security reporting
- Polished employee experience
  
  Business pricing varies by package.
  
  [Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is approximate and based on published 2026 plan information. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to 1Password and Bitwarden\:

| Consideration | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Cost | Higher | Lower |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Open source | No | Yes |


For a small business without dedicated IT staff, I'd lean toward 1Password. If keeping costs down is important, Bitwarden is an excellent alternative.

## Three questions to narrow it down

1\. **How many people?**

- 2–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50

2\. **What type of organization?**

- Small business
- Professional services / consulting
- Software / technology team
- Nonprofit
- Personal or family team

3\. **What's most important?**

- Ease of use
- Strongest security
- Lowest cost
- Sharing passwords with employees, contractors, and vendors
- Administrative control over who can access what

With those answers, I can recommend a specific product and plan rather than having you pay for enterprise features you don't need.
